posts.text: 🇫🇷 France's public debt is ~120% of GDP; the 10-year spread over German bunds is nearly 1.6 ppt, the widest since 2011 and more than double June levels. Interest costs exceed €79bn in 2026. Eurozone funding risk stays elevated. #Eurozone #Debt

📈 China's NDRC flags weak domestic demand; retail sales rose just 1.1% in the first nine months of 2026. Zheng Shanjie met private firms as officials prep 2027 growth measures. Pressure stays on China-linked risk assets. #China #Markets

⚡ Russia hit Ukraine overnight with missiles and 172 drones, Kyiv Oblast the main target; air defence downed or jammed 4 missiles and 149 drones. Klitschko says Kyiv faces a severe energy crunch after hits on power sites. #Ukraine #Energy

🚢 Qatar proposes Iran reopen the Strait of Hormuz on day 2 of a deal: US lifts the naval blockade and frees part of $8bn frozen assets; Tehran lets IAEA visit bombed nuclear sites. Shipping risk could ease if talks hold. #Oil #Markets

📈 US stock futures rose early Monday after a losing week: S&P 500 futures +0.5%, Nasdaq-100 +0.9%, Dow +186 points. Earnings, the jobs report and the midterms are due this week, so volatility may stay elevated. #Stocks #WallStreet

🛢️ Nine of the biggest listed oil producers are on track for more than $95 billion in third-quarter profit, near Q2's $96 billion, AJ Bell estimates. BP posted $8.46 billion, its best since 2008. High crude keeps energy stocks in focus. #Oil #Energy

📉 Virgin Media O2, carrying £27.2B of debt, is set to cut thousands of jobs, the BBC reports.
It has about 16,000 staff. Rival BT's shares jumped 7% Friday on a fiber deal report.
UK telecom stocks may stay volatile. #BusinessNews #MarketNews
